[[File:GeneralAzzameensTrophies-XWA.png|thumb|right|200px|Ace Azzameen's vast collection in his room on the ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'']]
'''Collectors''' were individuals who bought, collected, stole, or otherwise obtained rare and priceless treasures. These included artifacts, artwork, antiques or any kind of items they considered valuable. Some collectors sought various [[Species/Legends|species]] of animals.

[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] alike collected artifacts through the eras. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was perhaps the greatest collector of his (or possibly any) [[Time/Legends|time]]. He had a large collection of artifacts and treasures of all kinds which he kept all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in his [[Emperor's skyhook|Skyhook]], the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], and his storehouses and secret vaults. [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] collected [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] from Jedi he defeated as trophies. Others like [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] collected [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armors]] and weapons.

Many [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] and underworld kingpins were collectors as well. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] kept hoards of valuables in his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], while [[Borvo]] kept a collection of priceless objects and artifacts such as a [[King Tusken Rifle]] in his underground base on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

Some, like [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]], collected anything they personally found worthwhile. He kept various trinkets and items as mementos from his many adventures.
